# The video domain

The timeline: edit operations, history, lint, frames and sheets, export and transcribe jobs, templates.

## How to reach it

MCP tools: `edit`, `command_help`, `history`, `view`, `lint`, `job_start`, `job_get`, `job_cancel`, `template`. Tools that take `domain=video`: `edit`, `command_help`, `history`.

CLI: `stuarty video` lists the commands of the domain and `stuarty video <verb>` runs one; the full names stay valid.

- `edit`: apply a batch of operations to a project (its lint block is lint_scope fast: lint runs every rule)
- `history`: list the steps of a project history
- `undo`: undo the last step of the caller
- `redo`: redo the last undone step of the caller
- `lint`: check a project against every lint rule (an edit result runs only the fast rules, lint_scope fast)
- `view`: render a frame or a contact sheet of a project
- `export`: export a project to a file
- `job:show`: show a job
- `job:cancel`: cancel a queued or running job
- `job:list`: list the jobs of a project
- `template:list`: list the templates of the library
- `template:save`: make a template from a project
- `template:new`: create a project from a template
- `template:export`: write a template to a file the workspace keeps
- `template:import`: add a template file to the library
- `transcribe`: transcribe the audio of an asset
- `otio:export`: write the timeline of a project as an OpenTimelineIO file
- `otio:import`: apply an OpenTimelineIO file to a project as one undo step

## Operations

These 73 operations go in the `operations` of `edit` with `domain=video`, grouped by namespace; `command_help domain=video` lists them with their summaries and `command_help name=<operation> domain=video` gives the arguments of one.

- `asset`: remove
- `audio`: add, duck, mark_beats
- `caption`: add, edit_word, from_transcript, import_subtitles, merge, retime_from_clip, set_breaks, set_style, set_words, split
- `clip`: add, remove_silences, set_blend, set_blur, set_chroma_key, set_color, set_effects, set_filter, set_flip, set_framing, set_mask, set_outline, set_shadow, set_speed
- `font`: add, remove
- `item`: crossfade, delete, duplicate, extract_audio, freeze_frame, link, move, paste_attributes, rename, repeat, set_audio, set_enabled, set_transform, set_transition, slip, split, trim, unlink
- `keyframe`: clear, remove, set
- `marker`: add, remove, set
- `project`: rename
- `settings`: reframe, set, set_fps
- `shape`: add, set
- `slot`: fill, mark, unmark
- `template`: set_info
- `text`: add, apply_preset, set
- `timeline`: close_gap
- `track`: add, move, remove, set_caption_style, update
